LanguageData.FB_FleshPortalDispatchZone_DesignatorDes: A regular stockpile with filters and priority. Everything stored on it is automatically marked for transfer through the celestial umbilicus on this map, and regular haulers carry it: from the surface to the flesh moon, or from the moon to the surface. Things that arrived through the umbilicus are not sent back. Creating the stockpile costs nothing.
LanguageData.FB_FleshPortalDispatchZone_ToggleDesc: While enabled, everything on this stockpile is automatically marked for transfer through the celestial umbilicus. Things already marked are cleared with the umbilicus's cancel loading button.
LanguageData.FB_FleshPortalDispatchZone_InspectNoPort: Umbilicus dispatch: no working umbilicus on this map
